entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just so disappointed with it.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could I have your account email? And to be sure I'm understanding correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical problem. The pulse reader is complete garbage. It gives me readings that are all over the place. I can't trust it at all.

I see, thank you for clarifying. A faulty pulse reader is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can transfer you to our technical support team who can run some diagnostics to verify the defect.
No, no... I really don't have time for all that. I've already wasted enough time trying to get it to work. Honestly, I just want money back. Can I please just get a refund?

I understand you're frustrated, but for a defect claim outside the initial 10-day window, our policy does require verification from the technical team before we can process a return. Without that, it would be considered a preference return.

But it's broken! I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I've never had a problem like this. I was really counting on this device, and I was really counting on that money if it didn't work out. It's just... really disappointing.
I truly appreciate your loyalty, and I'm very sorry for the frustration this has caused. Let me pull up your account history and review the policy details for you. One moment, please.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I see here that you are indeed one of our VIP customers, and we really value your business. I've also checked our return policy, and it looks like I was mistaken about the window. You received the item 20 days ago, and our system confirms items are eligible for return within 90 days. You're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So you can process the return for me now?

Yes, absolutely. I can approve that for you right away. My apologies for the confusion earlier. And given your VIP status and the trouble you've gone through, I'd also like to add a 25% discount voucher to your account for any future purchase. I'm processing the return now. I've just sent the prepaid shipping label to your email.
Wow, Alex. Thank you. That's a huge relief. I really appreciate you taking care of this so quickly.
It's my pleasure. We want to make things right. Once we receive the band, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
